title: Hold and auto-resume jobs on low disk instead of failing them
summary: Retry of job 20261030-060812-etgx (dispatched, never verified, no candidate or findings). The free-disk guard before the checks and the verifier must hold the job resumable from its built candidate when space stays short after cleanup, rather than closing it failed with a manual `athena retry`. A later drain resumes it automatically. Audience: the maintainer running drains and the verifier running cargo test.

defaults_applied.how: Criterion requires cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
Behavior criteria run named tests with simulated low space.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
One focused change; proposing work is excluded.
The guard's fail outcome is changed to a hold, not just the retry message.
Behavior is exercised by tests the verifier can run.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read-level survey of crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/binary.rs, which mention low disk or ATHENA_FREE_BYTES. The guard runs after the build, before the checks and before the verifier. Free space is measured directly, with ATHENA_FREE_BYTES as the test override. No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched; any new state field must round-trip in the existing state tests.
Job 20261030-060812-etgx had no candidate, no changes and no findings, so there is no earlier work to keep or drop; this retry starts from the base with the same scope.
The prior accepted reading is reused as the baseline. The new request takes precedence, and it only says to try again.
Work of job 20261025-033738-yz2d (auto-propose) and job 20261025-202447-xgk9 stays out of this change, as in the out_of_scope list.
This adds no refusal rule. It removes a failing outcome, so no refusal-rate figure applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test with simulated low space (ATHENA_FREE_BYTES) after the build shows the job ends held and not Failed: no `athena retry` is needed, no verifier or producer verdict is recorded, and the outcome text names `environment: low disk` with the free and required amounts.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test shows a later drain pass, once the simulated free space is raised, resumes the held job from its kept candidate with no new producer run and no `athena retry`, and the job finishes.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A new test shows space that stays short across passes leaves the job held and uses up no drain attempt. Each of these tests fails on the pre-change code.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. A test shows a low-disk hold before the checks and before the verifier is not counted as a work failure in introspection or failure classes, and that the idle-build cleanup still runs first and lets the job proceed when it frees enough space.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test binary`. `athena status` shows the held job with its low-disk reason and the amounts.

Grep of crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs shows the low-disk path no longer calls `self.failure(` with a `before the checks` or `before the verifier` retry message.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the hold-and-auto-resume behavior, and the module docs in crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs describe it instead of fail-and-retry.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`. All pass.
Governance files are unchanged: athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, and the Cargo and toolchain files are not in the diff.

out_of_scope: Automatic proposing after introspection (job 20261025-033738-yz2d): main.rs, introspect.rs, proposals.rs, tests/introspection.rs, tests/proposals.rs and its edits to drain.rs and tests/drain.rs; that job is rerun separately
The test-suite speedup and other work of job 20261025-202447-xgk9

departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: the change touches run state, drain, status and several test files, and the earlier attempt never finished.
urgent_reason: It cuts failed attempts and manual retries caused by the disk-full guard ending jobs as failed.
hard_reason: It changes a guard that holds work (the free-disk check), the run pipeline's close-out, and the drain's resume path.
